candidates.description: Python Agent Framework for LLM Tool-Calling and Multi-Agent Orchestration
A Python SDK for orchestrating multi-step AI agent workflows with tool calling capabilities.
A modular Python template for LangGraph-based LLM agents with function/tool calling, featuring Ollama integration, multi-step reasoning, and visual workflow orchestration.
LangGraph-based Python demo project for building multi-step AI agent workflows with state management, tool calling, and graph-driven orchestration.

A practical demonstration of building and orchestrating tool-using language agents with Mistral LLMs and LangGraph. The project showcases both a minimal function-calling workflow and an advanced multi-step agent flow for structured, data-driven reasoning using Python tools and pandas.
